timezone_note: Build dates are America/Phoenix (UTC-7). Source timestamps that carry a zone are converted in the notes.
coordinate_policy: Coordinates are used only when an official dataset publishes them (EPA ICIS-NPDES facility GEOCODE_LATITUDE/GEOCODE_LONGITUDE, or Iowa DNR Facilities layer latitude/longitude). This project never geocodes addresses or place names. ICIS coordinates are marked approximate because the public download does not include a collection method. Iowa DNR points whose official collection method is address matching are also marked approximate. Every mapped point was tested against GADM 4.1 United States level-1 boundaries with a 1 km coastal tolerance; failures are withheld from the map and kept as list-only. USDA APHIS HPAI detections have no official farm coordinates and are list-only or county/state shaded, never plotted as points.
inventory_gap: EPA does not have a complete national inventory of concentrated animal feeding operations. In 2011 it proposed a CAFO reporting rule; on July 20, 2012 it withdrew that proposal and said it would instead use existing federal, state, and local sources (Federal Register withdrawal; EPA's CAFO regulations page). GAO-08-944 (2008) found that EPA did not have comprehensive, accurate information on the number of permitted CAFOs nationwide. This layer therefore shows NPDES records EPA does publish in ICIS-NPDES, plus official state points where a state posts them (Iowa DNR here), and it is not a complete map of U.S. poultry and cattle operations.
disclaimer: A permitted operation is not by itself proof of contamination. Permitted large operations, documented NPDES enforcement or single-event violations, Iowa DNR listed operations, and USDA disease detections are stored as distinct sub-layers. Living near a listed operation does not necessarily mean a person is at risk.

left_out.tri: EPA TRI industry-sector coverage (40 CFR 372.23 / EPA TRI-covered industry sectors page) does not include livestock and poultry production NAICS (112112, 112120, 1123xx). No TRI livestock-production facilities were expected or added.
left_out.attains_303d: ICIS facility rows can note that a receiving water is 303(d) listed, but that is not an official attribution of the impairment to the feeding operation. A national ATTAINS layer of waters impaired by animal feeding operations was not added in this layer.
left_out.state_gis_not_yet_ingested: Official CAFO/AFO GIS lists with coordinates were identified as candidates for North Carolina, Minnesota, Wisconsin, Texas, Kansas, Nebraska, Maryland, Arkansas, Georgia and Delaware, and are an open follow-up. Only Iowa DNR was ingested in this layer besides the national ICIS file.
left_out.swine_and_other_animals: Swine, sheep, goat, horse and similar operations were left out of the cattle and poultry layers except where Iowa DNR also lists cattle or poultry at the same facility (noted in animal_detail).
